# Rugby Play Designer

> A free browser app for designing rugby plays: players on a pitch, runs, passes and kicks, phase by phase, animated. A play is a JSON file, so an AI assistant can write one and put it straight into the app.

The app runs in the browser at https://playbook.samuelroiz.com with no account. Plays stay in the user's browser.

To make a play for someone:

1. Read the AI play guide below. It has the pitch coordinates, the exact JSON format, the rules the app uses to build each phase, realistic positions and a checklist.
2. Write the play as JSON, following the guide.
3. In the app, open File → Paste play… (the dialog `#paste-dialog`).
4. Paste the JSON into the box labelled "Play JSON" (`#paste-play-text`).
5. Press Import (`#paste-play-import`). The play opens as a new play (or, with "Replace the open play" chosen, replaces the open one, whose old version goes to Recently deleted); if it can't be used, the dialog shows why and keeps the text.

A saved `.json` file can also be opened with File → Load file….

## Docs

- [AI play guide](https://playbook.samuelroiz.com/docs/AI_PLAY_GUIDE.md): everything needed to write a play that loads and plays correctly
- [Worked example play](https://playbook.samuelroiz.com/templates/example.json): a finished three-phase play file
